description.text:
Coming soon to Harbord Square…

A purpose-built sports and leisure facility equipped with a state of the art Sports England designed sports hall, gym fitness room, training suite and so much more.  In2Sports, it’s the new way to play.

Whether it’s health and fitness or a lifestyle change that you are looking for, In2Sports offers amazing facilities, including our well-equipped and versatile Sports Hall, multi-function Cross-Fit and Yoga Room or relax and unwind with friends in “The Training Room”

In2Sport facilities are ideal for Community and Corporate events.  We are able to host all types of sports-based events, from football tournaments to team building events.

We look forward to welcoming you to In2Sports.
